title: Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In an alternate 1600 where Oda Nobunaga unified Japan, the dying ruler holds a single-elimination tournament to choose his successor. Sixteen warlords each sponsor a champion, famous historical warriors such as Honda Tadakatsu and Miyamoto Musashi, in fights where anything goes and death is encouraged.
life_message: Supreme martial skill and the will to win decide who is worthy to rule.

content.note: Death-match tournament between warriors (Wikipedia; AniList Death Game; MU Blood and Gore, Kill or Be Killed).
Lethal duels and survival stakes (AniList Survival; Wikipedia).

folkways.japan: It reimagines Sengoku and early Edo martial heroes such as Musashi and Honda Tadakatsu, a staple of Japanese historical fiction.
